_doc: Per-holding identity rulings by Drew. conform-holdings-to-catalog SCOPE=rulings applies ONLY these: the holding's current hobbyiqCardId must equal `from` (use `from: null` for a holding that has NO hobbyiqCardId yet), the `to` row must exist in card_catalog, and both cardId and hobbyiqCardId are set to `to` (one identity). An optional `fields` object corrects the holding's OWN text (year, setName, ...) in the same ruling, for a holding whose stored product is simply wrong. A product-changing move is what the bot refuses (CF-A-HOLDING-NEVER-ADOPTS-A-VENDOR-ROW); a ruling is the human saying so.

rulings.note: Ohtani HMT-1 is the Topps Chrome Update card
CPA-BA ships in the Bowman release; Bowman Chrome is the later product
CPA-FA ships in the Bowman release
2018 Topps Chrome #150 Refractor, pitching (the standard Refractor); the #9 came from PSA 9

Justin Gonzalez CPA-JG Refractor auto: CPA ships in the Bowman release. The catalog spells the player 'Justin Gonzales' (beckett-checklist) -- Drew: same player. The holding had no hobbyiqCardId; its cardId pointed at the bowman-chrome twin. Already pinned by the conform pass on 2026-08-30, so the ruling reports `already` and skips -- kept as the written record of the decision.

Jac Caglianone RA-JC Refractor auto: the holding said 2024 Bowman Draft but its eBay title says 2026 Topps Chrome. The 2026 Topps Chrome RA-JC Refractor auto is /499 (checklistcenter-2026-08-29); the holding's own year/setName are corrected with it.
Derek Jeter 1997 BBP4 Atomic Refractor: the stored id said `bowman`; the card is Bowman's Best (baseballcardpedia). The holding's cardId already pointed at the right row.

Ken Griffey Jr 1999 D24: the only checklist-authority row is baseballcardpedia's `black-diamond` base row -- both `upper-deck-black-diamond` rows are sold-comps-stub (derived) and the checklist does NOT number the base card (the /1500 is the Triple's short-set print run, D24 Triple). No :num-1500 row exists.

Ken Griffey Jr 1992 Studio #232 base. The stored id carried a literal 'undefined' setKey segment. `donruss-studio` is the spelling the slug generator mints (studio -> donruss-studio) and the D23 product table names; 327 tcdb-scrape checklist rows back it against 279 baseballcardpedia rows under bare `studio`.
